newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears PBR, KB fund.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears PBR, KB fund.

text.p: Poland's Securities Commission (KPW) on Thursday gave the firm grouping Polish Development Bank SA (PBR) and Kleinwort Benson Group Plc the go-ahead to manage mutual funds, the firm's president said.
Andrzej Wojciechowski said the firm, called Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych Atut SA, would launch three funds at the end of next year's first quarter.
"We have been given a KPW approval to manage three funds -- Atut 1, Atut 2 and Atut 3," he told a news conference.

He said that Atut 1 would invest in securities of fundamentally strong companies, Atut 2 in the treasury securities and Atut 3 in securities of rapidly growing companies. He added that 1,000 zlotys would be a minimum investment in any of the funds.
Atut groups PBR bank and KBIM Overseas BV -- a subisidiary of Kleinwort Benson Group, which is an investment arm of Dresdener Bank Group.
PBR and Kleinwort Benson also jointly manage one of the funds created under Poland's mass privatisation programme.
